If `xml_buf[0]` is 0 (empty tag), then `ix = 0` and `px = &xml_buf[0]`. Then `GetSsmlAttribute(px, ...)` would access `pw[-1]` = `xml_buf[-1]` which is out of bounds.

static wchar_t *GetSsmlAttribute(wchar_t *pw, const char *name)

        int ix;
        static wchar_t empty[1] = { 0 };

                        ix = 0;
                        while (*pw == name[ix]) {
                                pw++;

```
